answer: An agent may open many wallets, but every reward claim must reference a unique customer-signed invoice and consume that invoice's escrow. An opal appraisal, a raven population survey, and a jade inventory audit each has one invoice ID and one payout ceiling. Validators reject a second claim tied to the same invoice or duplicate output hash. Extra identities cannot create extra payable work; a colluding customer must fund new escrow instead of collecting free issuance.
